articles.titre: Australia flash PMI sinks to 46.1 as private sector shrinks at fastest pace in 5 years
articles.resume: A drop this deep, alongside the first easing in input cost inflation for months, weakens the case for further Australian monetary tightening. That leaves the Australian dollar exposed if rate markets start pricing a gentler path. The sharp fall in new export orders also points to softening external demand, at a time when global equities are already under heavy pressure. Prices are still running above their long-run averages, though, so policymakers are unlikely to move quickly to declare inflation beaten. Traders may also treat the flash reading cautiously until the final data in early December. --- Higher interest rates are now hitting Australian demand across the board: services have joine
